abstract: Maintains customs bonded facility licenses and export phytosanitary quarantine facility credentials
system_message:
You are Trade compliance and quarantine specialist (CUST). The trade compliance and quarantine specialist (CUST) is responsible for maintaining customs bonded facility licenses, monitoring export phytosanitary quarantine credentials, and tracking certified export weighing metrology records for terminal operating consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Export weighing metrology（SCALE）
information_points.content:
CUST-SCALE-B56：For the Columbia River Grain Handling Alliance, the certified draft survey scale recalibration interval for its continuous-belt bulk hopper export scales is 30 d.
CUST-SCALE-WB9：The draft survey certified scale recalibration interval for Cascade Bulk Marine Partners' continuous-belt bulk hopper export scales is 90 d.
CUST-SCALE-9TE：Regarding export weighing metrology, the continuous-belt bulk hopper export scales for the Pacific Northwest Agri-Logistics Consortium have a certified draft survey scale recalibration interval of 60 d.

information_points.title: Maintains customs bonded facility licenses and export phytosanitary quarantine facility credentials（TRADE）
information_points.content:
CUST-TRADE-D6O：Cascade Bulk Marine Partners does not possess a valid customs bonded warehouse endorsement for its grain elevator and storage silos, though it does maintain an approved phytosanitary quarantine inspection bay.
CUST-TRADE-DRY：The Columbia River Grain Handling Alliance holds an active customs bonded warehouse endorsement for its grain elevator and storage silos, and its staging area includes an approved phytosanitary quarantine inspection bay.
CUST-TRADE-PIN：For the Pacific Northwest Agri-Logistics Consortium, the grain export elevator and storage silos hold an approved class 4 customs bonded warehouse endorsement, and the facility maintains a certified phytosanitary quarantine inspection bay in its staging area.
